surface_mechanism_description: The open-coordinated structure of the Ru precursor promoted nucleophilic addition during ALD processing, which eliminated the incubation step and gave rise to a uniform Ru thin film. The addition of oxygen to the ligand is essential in Ru ALD processing, as it promotes nucleation by enhancing these reactions.
